slides.texte_overlay:
Habits that quietly earn a man
respect everywhere he goes

1. He holds the door

For anyone. Every time.

2. He answers emails the same day

Even if it's "I'll get back to you".

3. He drives calm

No horn. No tailgating.

4. He pays his share without
being asked

No awkward math.

5. He remembers what you told him

And asks about it later.

6. He can talk about anything

A little history, science, art.
He keeps learning.

Use a micro-learning app
